spatialDescription: Section marker at top with KEY INSIGHTS label. Full-width action heading below. Three equal columns for challenge analysis: manufacturing scale constraints (left), supply chain complexity (center), capital intensity requirements (right) - each column contains challenge description, affected sectors bullets, and funding gap data. Below columns: colored accent panel spanning full width containing scaling bottleneck examples with company names and specific metrics. Bottom zone: stats row displaying average capital requirement, median time-to-commercialization, and failure rate percentages.
